title: Texas registered agent and registered office
rule: Every Texas filing entity, and every foreign entity registered in Texas, must keep a registered agent and registered office in Texas at all times. The agent is a Texas resident or an organization authorized to do business in Texas, never the entity itself, and must consent in writing or electronically. The office is a street address where the agent can be served in person, not just a mailbox or answering service. Filing a change of agent or office costs $15, or $5 for a nonprofit corporation or cooperative association.
changeWatch: Amendments to Business Organizations Code chapter 5, subchapter E, or to the filing fees in sections 4.152 to 4.154 and 4.161, or to the Secretary of State's registered agent forms and fees.
